claim: The record-closure verification participated in the reviewed-set digest that it was supposed to validate, creating a fixed-point deadlock.
evidence: The canonical Verification could not become PASS until ACCEPT existed.
ACCEPT digest changed when canonical Verification became PASS.
impact: A valid audited record set could not be closed.
required_action: Separate record-closure evidence from reviewed-set hashing and add an explicit pre-closure phase.

prevention.action: record_closure evidence is excluded from reviewed_set_digest; check-records --pre-closure bootstraps the final full check.
